en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Seeing (Dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, whose root is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and whose root is not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root;
three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, whose root is not to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive, whose root is not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition.
